    D_Y_HI_2: tl.constexpr,

    batch = tl.program_id(1)

    sin_d2_offsets = tl.arange(0, D_SIN_2)

    lo_cos = x_lo_tile * cos_tile

    hi_sin = x_hi_tile * sin_tile

    lo_sin = x_lo_tile * sin_tile

        raise ValueError("out must provide 2 output tensors")

        (out[0], (8, 512, 64), torch.float32),

        D_COS_1=512,
